title: The Houses that Can't be Built in America - The Missing Middle
summary: Not Just Bikes explains missing middle housing, such as duplexes, townhouses and small apartment buildings. The video argues that zoning in the US and Canada has made these options almost illegal.
why: Recommended as the standard short overview of missing middle housing and its link to zoning reform.
